hardware_observation.screen: stopped at BASIC READY. RUN: without a Lisp65 banner or prompt
hardware_observation.processor_activity: repeating PCs in the owned IRQ handler around $e028..$e041
hardware_observation.first_red_rule: stopped; no downstream hardware case was claimed

breakpoint_diagnosis.cpu_view_d019_and_d700: matched physical Bank-0 RAM rather than VIC-IV and DMAgic I/O
breakpoint_diagnosis.irq_effect: the raster IRQ source could not be acknowledged, producing an IRQ storm
breakpoint_diagnosis.core_source_result: gs4510 MAP translation takes precedence over the I/O mapping for mapped blocks

root_cause.mechanism: The $c0 MAP mask mapped both $c000-$dfff and $e000-$ffff. Mapping block 6 hid the $d000 I/O aperture required by the owned VIC, CIA and DMA paths.
root_cause.why_ready_run_remained_visible: The CPU was trapped in the unacknowledgeable raster IRQ before product screen ownership completed.

required_fix_and_gate.product_fix: Use the $80 MAP mask so only $e000-$ffff is replaced and $d000 I/O remains visible.
required_fix_and_gate.permanent_gate: Disassembly and mutations bind exactly the E000-only MAP sequence and reject C000-inclusive masks.
required_fix_and_gate.hardware_recheck: A fresh candidate must restart the receipt-less pre-smoke at manual step 1; no Link-23 green is inherited.

claim_limit: Receipt-less hardware diagnosis of Link 23 only. It proves a first-red in MAP/I/O coexistence and no hardware acceptance, product promotion or release claim.
